transcript.text: hotpoint SA2 oven not heatin on fan, grill ok. wat does SA2 mean??

SA2 is simply Hotpoint’s model code for this specific cooker design; it doesn’t indicate a fault. Since your grill works but the fan oven isn't heating, the most likely cause is that the fan oven heating element has failed (it's separate from the grill element). Another possibility is a fault in the function selector switch or thermostat. To help narrow this down: when you turn the knob to the fan oven setting, does the fan inside the oven start spinning?
no the fan isnt spinning, just a low hum from the back

That low hum is the sound of the fan motor trying to turn but being unable to. Since it isn't spinning at all, this points strongly to either the fan blade being physically stuck (perhaps by burnt-on food debris) or the fan motor itself having failed internally. Please switch the oven off at the wall and unplug it (or isolate the fuse). Once cool, reach in and try to spin the fan blade by hand. Does it turn freely without grinding or catching, or does it feel stuck? If it is stiff or seized, that suggests the motor needs replacing.
isolated it at the cooker switch n checked. fan is very stiff, feels gritty when i turn it by hand. also had a slight hot smell from the back once, not now tho

⚠ Stop using this appliance
A burning or hot-plastic smell, smoke, scorching or melting can mean an electrical fault or a fire risk. Stop using it, switch it off and unplug it (or turn it off at the fuse box), and don't run it again — not even as a test — until it has been checked by a qualified engineer. That stiff, gritty feeling suggests the fan motor bearings are likely failing or there is a blockage preventing it from turning. Because the motor is seized and has already shown signs of overheating (the smell), this is not something that can be safely fixed by simply resetting settings. It requires an engineer to open up the oven, isolate the electrical connections properly, and replace the fan motor or clear the obstruction. Please do not try to force the fan or use the oven again until it has been checked, as forcing a seized motor could cause further damage or create a fire risk.
